gitCommit.subject: fix(console): every name in both scripts, checked beside its field; never the API's validation words
gitCommit.body:
fix(console): every name in both scripts, checked beside its field; never the API's validation words

Creating a business on dukan-test answered "ownerNameAr must be a string"
and "businessNameAr must be a string": the deployed console predates the
Arabic name fields the API now requires. This change, on top of 638f1d6
(which added those fields), makes the forms say what is wrong themselves:

- src/lib/names.ts mirrors the API's name rules exactly
  (erp-backend common/bilingual-name.ts): Latin and Arabic scripts, blank,
  length, hidden characters.
- New business: each Latin field is labelled "(Latin letters)", each Arabic
  field is right-to-left; the business's and the Owner's two names are
  required, the first store's two go together or not at all (as the DTO).
  Checked before the step-up, the message beside the field in the
  operator's language, a summary above the buttons; nothing is sent and
  nothing typed is lost. The browser's own bubbles are off (noValidate).
- Names editor (business, store, person) and the Owner portal's store
  request (Arabic name optional there, as the API has it) use the same
  rules and field messages.
- Field takes an error, outside the label (the field keeps its name) and
  pointed to by aria-describedby.
- ErrorNotice: the API's validation wording is never shown — "check the
  highlighted fields" instead; other server sentences only on an English
  screen; a refusal the page worded itself still shows in every language.

Tests: bilingual creation with every name mapped to its field, missing
Arabic names, wrong scripts, a store's Arabic name alone, a raw 400 never
shown with the answers kept, FR and AR field messages, the mirrored rules.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
